title: Remo
desc: SK, an aspiring actor, falls in love with Kavya, a doctor. However, she is engaged to another man and SK tries to sabotage their relationship by making her fall for him.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: Echo
desc: Desperation sets in when Prakash's failing marriage is threatened by something otherworldly, prompting him to resort to black magic. He soon uncovers shocking family revelations.

title: Poojai
desc: A temple priest gives evidence in court about a murder that he has witnessed. Unfortunately for him, he bears witness against an influential landlord.

title: Sakthi
desc: After Sakthi foils Sethupati's attempt to steal the temple idols and jewels, he begins to guard the temple himself. Later, he learns that Sita, a woman ostracised by the village, is his mother.

title: Jilla
desc: Residents of an island village face danger during boat travel to the mainland. The island president dreams of a bridge and sends his son to investigate a long delay.
